name: WorkMate.Test.AdditiveUnknownAttachable
displayName: TEST FIXTURE: an additive row naming a type that does not exist
$fixtureNotes: NOT A SHIPPED RECIPE. One row, one mistake: addEmployeeAttachableTypeCodes names a dimension type code no tenant has.

It exists to hold the line between the two things an additive row can meet. A type that is ALREADY permitted — because the structure's attachable set is empty and therefore unconstrained — is already satisfied and is skipped. A type that DOES NOT EXIST is a row naming something that is not there, and is refused by name.

Those two were once the same branch, and the wrong half won: a real tenant whose zenith-org placed employees anywhere had the positions recipe refused on 15 October. Keeping the refusal tested is what stops the fix going too far the other way and swallowing a typo.
description: TEST DATA — applies to a tenant that already has zenith-org, and must fail naming the type code.
